g.text: OptunaHub AutoSampler (GP) versus standard TPE at 200 trials

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #68737d

g.text: Three matched seeds; the wafer waveform is fitted and upper reflection is retained as an unused output.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #68737d

g.text: Fitted waveform: median nRMSE Auto/GP 1.102e-04, TPE 1.741e-04 (ratio 0.633).

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #68737d

g.text: Unused reflection: median nRMSE Auto/GP 3.263e-03, TPE 2.564e-03. Execution: 1200 trials, 1150 new solves, 50 cache hits, 0 failures.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #68737d

g.text: Assessment: Auto/GP improves the fitted objective, but repeated proposals and worse hold-out prevent a general superiority claim.
